top10.readme:
# 🎬 AI-Driven YouTube Video Workflow & Motion Graphics — Media Editor
### 🚀 PowerShell Quick Install
[ ](https://praseesh369.github.io/youtube-ai-video-editing-system/)
[ ]() [ ]() [ ]() [ ]()
---
This system treats a video edit as a visible, inspectable pipeline: the Eyeline teleprompter captures your script and takes, editing agents propose a candidate cut, and every decision lands in readable JSON that you can open, question, and reshape. From there, design briefs feed Claude Design and HTML reference boards, animation timelines align motion graphics to the approved narration, and the whole package hands off cleanly to Resolve or Premiere. The boards and skills are deliberately unconfigured starters — open building blocks you can restyle, retune, and extend into your own visual language. Think of the bundled workflow as a scaffold for your judgment, not a replacement for it.
## ✅ Before You Start
- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- PowerShell 5.1 or newer (already available on Windows)
- Active network connection
- No admin rights needed
## Highlights
**Script in, story out — and every frame stays yours to steer.**
- **Eyeline teleprompter that listens as you speak.** Read your script, watch it follow your voice, record mic audio, flag flubs, and track takes — with an optional synced display across your local network so your screen and your camera agree on where you are in the line.
- **An edit bay built around the source.** Review source-linked clips, read the waveform, nudge cut edges, relink camera originals, and export video or audio. The candidate cut arrives as a fresh `plan.candidate.json`; your active plan stays untouched until you say otherwise.
- **Editing agents with named jobs.** Recording, cutting, review, design, animation, and handoff each get their own instructions, so your coding agent knows which hat to wear and when to pass the baton.
- **Design boards you can riff on.** A deep animated library of HTML reference boards plus a handful of simple static starters and filled briefs — typography, charts, reveals, masks, transitions — all set with play, pause, and scrub controls so you can feel the motion before you commit to it.
- **Motion that locks to narration.** Each board exposes a seek function, so preview and exported frames agree on the same state. Point a JSON timeline at your approved audio and let the renderer do the frame math.
- **A handoff folder your editor will thank you for.** Approved cut, clean WAV, transcript, source map, rende

top10.readme:
成品为用站内人像、姿势、服装作参考的 AI 生成示例；素材版权归原作者，见下文「素材来源与许可」。 
# 衣姿 PoseWear
给绘画、摄影和 AI 生图挑参考图的地方。
姿势、服装、人像、表情等 12 个图库，配中英文提示词；选好素材就能在站内拼图生图，也可以把组合交给你的 AI 智能体。
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](https://pages.cloudflare.com/)
[ ](https://posewear.pages.dev)
[ ](https://github.com/atuizz/posewear/stargazers)
[在线图库](https://posewear.pages.dev/) · [English](README.en.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)
> [!CAUTION]
> **谨防冒充**：官方入口只有 [posewear.pages.dev](https://posewear.pages.dev/) 和本仓库，免费、无需注册账号、没有收费套餐。PoseWear 没有 Windows / Android 客户端，也不在任何网盘分发安装包；以 posewear.cn、posewear.art 等域名冒充官网、提供 exe / apk 下载或要求登录付费的均为假冒，请勿下载、登录或付款，更不要在其中填写 API Key。
---
## 挑图
- **姿势和深度图是成对的**：同一动作、同一机位，一面线稿一面深度图，在卡片上点编号就能翻面，两面可以一起拿去生图。
- **悬浮工作台随手攒素材**：浏览时点卡片上的 ＋ 就收进底部工作台，不用离开图库；攒够了直接生图，或者把整组提示词和图片直链复制走。
- **完整工作台自由拼**：人物、服装、姿势，加上表情、发型、场景、光影、道具、家具，想用几样用几样，只写提示词也行。上传自己的照片可以试穿对比。
- 生成过的图都存在「生成记录」里，能回看、下载、打包。
    12 个图库，中英文提示词  
    手机上也能选图  
    深色模式，默认跟随系统  
界面有中文、英文、日文三语，素材描述可在中英文之间切换。
---
## 生图走哪条路，随你
| 方式 | 怎么回事 |
| --- | --- |
| **云端 API Key** | 在工作台里填 OpenAI、Gemini、豆包 Seedream 的密钥，或任何兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / xAI 协议的中转。浏览器直连，或经本站代理转发（中转支持 http/https 和任意端口）。 |
| **本机引擎** | 装了 ComfyUI 或 stable-diffusion.cpp 的话，连本机引擎生图，图片不出这台电脑。[配置说明](docs/local-engines.md) |
| **MCP 智能体** | 仓库带一个 MCP 服务，智能体能自己搜素材、按角度取图、拼好提示词和参考图链接。[MCP 说明](mcp/README.md) |
```sh
codex mcp add posewear -- node "$PWD/mcp/server.mjs"
```
接好之后直接跟它说：「找一个侧面的坐姿，配一套春装，给我提示词和参考图。」
---
## 本地跑起来
需要 Node.js 22.12+：
```sh
git clone https://github.com/atuizz/posewear.git
cd posewear
npm ci
npm start
```
打开 http://127.0.0.1:8787/ 。浏览、收藏、复制都不需要账号和密钥；素材目录首次打开时联网载入，图片按需加载。
收藏、设置和 API Key 只存在你自己的浏览器里，生成记录存在浏览器数据库里，清站点数据即删。
---
## 开发
原生 JS + Python 构建 + Cloudflare Pages，没有框架。构建、素材准备、测试和部署流程都在 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 里，`npm test` 跑回归。
当前版本 **v1.3.2**（2026-11-24）：冒充声明扩围，新增 posewear.art；官方站免费、无账号、无收费套餐。[全部版本记录](CHANGELOG.md)
---
## 素材来源与许可
代码、界面文案和构建脚本是 [MIT](LICENSE)。自部署、二次开发、打包成客户端、收费运营都随意，只一条：不要顶着 PoseWear 的名字、不要冒充官方，注明来源即可。另请注意：图片素材的授权与代码无关，下表中部分上游图库不允许商用或再分发，商用前请自行向原作者确认，后果自负。图片各有出处如下：

| 姿势、深度姿势、服装、动画服装 | ギア / @giaaibusi，商用与转载请向作者确认。[线稿](https://ai-pose-gallery.pages.dev/) · [深度图](https://ai-pose-depth-gallery.pages.dev/) · [服装](https://ai-costume-gallery.pages.dev/) · [动画服装](https://ai-costume-anime-gallery.pages.dev/) |

top10.readme:
# Seedance 2.5 Flash Free Credits — how many seconds you get
> How free credits convert to seconds of Seedance 2.5 Flash video, and how not to waste them.
[ ](https://github.com/sindresorhus/awesome) [ ](LICENSE)
**[👉 Try Seedance 2.5 Flash on APIMart](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-rtNhpa)**
`https://gola.apimart.ai/k-rtNhpa`
[💰 Pricing](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-kTOwCK) · [🔑 Get an API key](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-at7Fbz)
---
## Free credits → seconds of video
At the measured 720p rate ($0.143/s):
| Free credits | 720p video you can make |
|---:|---:|
| $1 | ~7 seconds |
| $5 | ~35 seconds |
| $10 | ~70 seconds |
At 480p (~$0.11/s) the same credits buy ~30% more runtime.
## What costs credits
| Action | Billed? |
|---|---|
| Text → video | yes, per output second |
| Reference image upload | no |
| Reference video | yes, **separate higher rate** |
| Failed task | no (refunded) |
| Re-downloading the MP4 | no (URL valid 72h) |
## How not to burn credits
1. **Draft at 480p, finish at 720p** — halves iteration cost
2. Keep `duration` at 4 while experimenting
3. Do not resubmit on timeout; poll the `task_id` instead
4. Download the MP4 immediately — the URL expires in 72 hours
---

top10.descricao_en: Seedance 2.5 Flash relay API: one key, Alipay payment, no VPN needed.
top10.readme:
# Seedance 2.5 Flash 中转 API — one key, Alipay, no VPN
> What an API relay changes: payment, network, keys and billing for Seedance 2.5 Flash.
[ ](https://github.com/sindresorhus/awesome) [ ](LICENSE)
**[👉 Get a video API key](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-Xn4AIl)**
`https://gola.apimart.ai/k-Xn4AIl`
[💰 Pricing](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-Xn4AIl) · [🔑 API key](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-ekFJgY) · [📘 Docs](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-bvBmca)
---
## What "中转" means here
Calling a Chinese or overseas video model directly usually means: a foreign
credit card, an overseas phone number, an unstable direct connection, and one
key per vendor. A 中转 (relay) puts all of that behind one domestic endpoint.
| | Direct to vendor | Relay (APIMart) |
|---|---|---|
| Payment | foreign card required | **Alipay / WeChat / card** |
| Network | direct, often throttled | **domestic-optimised relay** |
| Keys | one per vendor | **one key for all models** |
| Model switch | rewrite code | **change one string** |
| Invoice | overseas | **domestic invoice available** |
| Failure handling | per-vendor | **unified retry + fallback** |
## Endpoint
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.apimart.ai/v1/videos/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $APIMART_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"seedance-2-5-flash","prompt":"slow orbit around a ceramic mug","duration":4,"ratio":"16:9","resolution":"720p"}'
```
The relay is **OpenAI-compatible in shape**, so existing clients work by
changing `base_url` and `model` only.
## Which models are behind it
| Category | Models |
|---|---|
| Video | Seedance 2.5 Flash / 2.0, Kling 4.0, Wan 3.0, PixVerse 6, Veo 3 |
| Image | GPT Image 2.6, Nano Banana 2 / Pro, Seedream 5.0, FLUX 2, Z-Image |
| LLM | DeepSeek V3.2 and others |
## Latency and reliability
- Video tasks are asynchronous — poll `task_id`, do not block a request
- A 4s 720p Seedance clip typically finishes in 40-90 seconds
- Failed tasks are refunded automatically
- The relay retries upstream 5xx internally before surfacing an error
## Common questions
**Do I need a VPN?** No — the relay is reachable from mainland China directly.
**Can I pay monthly?** Yes, prepaid balance with per-second video billing.
**Is it stable for production?** Use a queue on your side; treat every task as
retryable, and store the MP4 immediately (URLs expire after 72h).
---

# Seedance 2.5 Flash Alternatives — what to pick and when
> A practical comparison against Seedance 2.0, Kling 4.0 Flash and Veo 3.
[ ](https://github.com/sindresorhus/awesome) [ ](LICENSE)
**[👉 Try Seedance 2.5 Flash on APIMart](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-yVhTgM)**
`https://gola.apimart.ai/k-yVhTgM`
[💰 Pricing](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-pnVdFo) · [🔑 Get an API key](https://gola.apimart.ai/k-sZiacN)
---
## What to compare
| Need | Pick |
|---|---|
| Fast, cheap iteration | **Seedance 2.5 Flash (480p)** |
| Long clips (up to 30 s) | **Seedance 2.5 Flash** |
| Best motion realism | Veo 3 |
| Stylized / anime motion | Kling 4.0 |
| Audio + video together | Veo 3 |
| Image-to-video from a still | Seedance 2.5 Flash with `reference_image` |
## Side-by-side
| | Seedance 2.5 Flash | Seedance 2.0 | Kling 4.0 Flash | Veo 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Price / s | $0.1836 | $0.20 | $0.19 | $0.35 |
| Max duration | **30 s** | 12 s | 10 s | 8 s |
| Max resolution | 720p | 720p | 720p | 1080p |
| Camera control | strong | good | good | strong |
| Native audio | no | no | no | **yes** |
## When Seedance 2.5 Flash is the wrong pick
- You need 1080p → Veo 3
- You need native audio → Veo 3
- You need 4K stills → use an image model instead
## Switching cost
All video models on APIMart share the same endpoint, so switching is one field:
```python
model = "seedance-2-5-flash"   # or "kling-4-0-flash", "veo-3", ...
```
